## Maintainer ruling recorded — A: the OSV scan runs daily; no automatic card producer yet

Director seat, summon #11, session `session_01ShyhexkB2d1AeRZ85tgAAe`, 2026-09-03.

Provenance (who / verbatim / where): maintainer, live PM chat with the director seat, 2026-09-03, replying to decision batch #20 in which this card was item 5 with the recommendation A (fallback B). Verbatim reply: 「其他同意」 — adopts A.

**Ruled: A.** The `osv-scanner.yml` schedule moves from weekly to daily (one cron line), so the discovery window for a new advisory shrinks from up to six days to one and a seat is far more likely to see the scheduled red before an unrelated PR collides with it. Option B (a scheduled red opens a card automatically) is **not built now**: it is a new automatic producer whose dedupe and close rules would have to be ruled with it, and the measured pull (six collisions in a month) is answered by the cadence first. Recorded fallback: if a daily red is measured going unseen until a PR collides with it, B returns as its own card with the dedupe / close rules in the same proposal.

Execution: `domain:devx` lane, S, `.github/workflows/osv-scanner.yml`; `skip-changeset`; `Clause-②: no`.

State transition, same stroke: `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue`. Ledger: director seat post #12708, summon #11.

## ACCEPT — PR #14934, reviewed 2026-09-03T11:24Z by `session_012zGPuVVX3deAx9LdjK8jCk`

Checked against the diff and `origin/main`, not the report.

| item | reading |
|:--|:--|
| PR form | draft, base `main`, first line `Fixes #14645`, `skip-changeset` + `size/xs` |
| governed surface | **clean** — `.github/workflows/**` is explicitly NOT governed (`docs/adr/**` · `.claude/**` · `skills/**` · `AGENTS.md` · `CLAUDE.md` is the whole list) ⇒ normal ready→queue path |
| scope | **1 file, +5/−2** — `.github/workflows/validate-deps.yml` only |
| the change | `- cron: '0 3 * * 1'` → `+ cron: '0 3 * * *'` — one field, same 03:00 UTC hour |
| ruling fidelity | Option A exactly; ⛔ no Option B issue-opening step; ⛔ #14639's four advisories not folded in |

### The judgement call in it that was right

The dispatch asked for "one cron line". The dev also rewrote the adjacent comment — which reads as scope creep for about two seconds, and is in fact the correct minimum: the old comment said *"Run weekly on Monday at 03:00 UTC"*. Changing only the cron would have left a comment asserting **weekly** directly above a **daily** schedule — a fresh declared ≠ enforced contradiction, in the same three lines, introduced by a card whose whole subject is discovery lag. The four added lines say what changed and why, and cite the card. ⇒ Correct, not creep.

### The ruling's filename slip, handled the way I asked

The ruling names `.github/workflows/osv-scanner.yml`. **That file does not exist** — I measured this at 11:01Z before dispatching, and the dev re-measured it independently. The ruling's *substance* (weekly → daily) was applied to `validate-deps.yml`, the file the card's own body names and the one that actually carries both the `schedule:` trigger and `issues: write`. ⛔ Nothing was re-adjudicated; the slip is clerical and is recorded in the PR body.

### Gates

29 dispatched families derived by the dev from its own tree post-commit and re-derived at the final HEAD (identical list — so no gate was introduced by the last commit and then left unrun), all exit 0, **captured before any pipe** by the redirect-then-`$?`-then-read pattern. YAML re-validated with `yaml.safe_load`, which is the one check that matters for a workflow edit and is not implied by any of the 29.

### Landing — not yet armed, deliberately

**CI on `663dc6670f` at 11:23Z: 17 success / 12 skipped / `Lint & Repo Gates` still `in_progress`.** Enqueue eligibility is **every** check green, not the required subset, so this waits. Flip + arm on convergence; a red there is this PR's to explain, not to re-run.

⚠️ Process note recorded against this dispatch: the dev's first turn ended with the gate suite handed to a background watcher, which is a stall, not a completion — nothing would have restarted it. It was reset to foreground execution immediately rather than after any silence threshold, and the second turn ran all 29 gates in-turn. The delivery above is that second turn's.

## LANDED — PR #14934 MERGED 12:01:13Z; probe on `origin/main`

`domain:devx` seat, session `session_012zGPuVVX3deAx9LdjK8jCk`, R1.

```
$ git show origin/main:.github/workflows/validate-deps.yml | sed -n '20,24p'
  schedule:
    # Run daily at 03:00 UTC — narrows the discovery window for a new OSV
    # advisory from up to six days (weekly) to one, ...
```
Merge commit `3210b3d5d` confirmed an **ancestor of `origin/main`** (`git merge-base --is-ancestor`, exit 0). Option A as ruled; ⛔ no Option B producer built; ⛔ #14639's advisories untouched.

⚠️ **A reading worth recording, because it nearly became a false regression report.** My first probe after the merge notification still showed `cron: '0 3 * * 1'` — *weekly*. The change had not reverted: my local `origin/main` ref was fetched **before** the 12:01:13Z merge. `origin/main` is a local ref that only a `fetch` moves, and a merge notification does not move it. **Re-fetch before every post-merge probe**; without that step this close-out would have reported a landed change as missing.
